repos_data.description: 👑 The all-in-one macOS menu bar companion: customizable controls, system monitor, AI Agent, Shortcuts, widgets, remote control, and more.
CodexIsland - AI usage limits in your MacBook notch
Lightweight Dynamic Island for macOS with AI coding agent notifications
🙈 macOS menu bar utility to hide the notch and round screen corners

Free, open-source notch app for MacBooks: now playing, file shelf, calendar, Reminders, notes, shortcuts, timers, camera mirror, and your Claude, Codex, Cursor, and Copilot usage. Native SwiftUI, near-zero idle CPU.
See when Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode or pi need you, and answer from the Mac notch. Free, open source, local-only.

Free, open-source notch app for MacBook: turns the Mac notch into a Dynamic Island-style live status area with now playing, a focus timer, your next meeting with a camera mirror, weather, notes, Keep Awake (lid closed too), AirPods battery and a volume and brightness HUD. macOS 26+. Your MacBook's notch, put to work.
Native macOS TOTP authenticator: your two-factor codes in a panel below the notch, one shortcut away. Developer ID signed and notarized.
The world's smallest coworker lives in your Mac's notch. Peek, a tiny 3D character, watches Claude Code and Codex so you don't have to. brew install --cask deepshal99/tap/notch-so-good
NotchMuse v0.8.0: synced macOS lyrics for Spotify, Apple Music, NetEase, QQ Music and Soda Music. Menu bar, notch, side and Dock lyrics with in-app updates.
Your MacBook notch, finally useful. Music, live system stats, AI chat (Claude, Gemini, Ollama), clipboard, shelf and alerts in a free, open-source macOS island.

Free, open-source AI assistant for macOS. Talk about your screen, get spoken step-by-step guidance and visual answers, and delegate tasks to specialist mates. Native SwiftUI; bring your own Claude, ChatGPT or compatible API.
A quiet notch on your Mac's screen edge that keeps your Notion pages and tasks one hover away. Native Swift, free.

A free, open-source Dynamic Island for the MacBook notch: music controls, a drag-and-drop file shelf, clipboard history, a focus timer that blocks apps and sites, thirteen widgets and Claude Code status. Works without a notch too.
Your GitHub pull requests and Actions in the MacBook notch.
A minimal notch monitor for Claude Code and Codex on macOS. Answer their questions and jump to their sessions from the notch.
